calendar.matters:
AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-04-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Bura, CSR: Linda Chavez.
Petitioner: Jorge Luis Antimo, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for Jennifer Molina Antimo and George Julian Anitmo Molino, the Minors. Petitioner was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Minors' Names to: Jennifer Antimo Molina and George Julian Antimo Molina.
Decree signed in open court.
